questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

⇒ The relationship between the words "Cockpit" and "Aeroplane" is that the cockpit is a part of an aeroplane. 

Let's check each option,

1) Student ∶ Class

→ Student is a part of Class. 

2) House ∶ Room

→ House is not a part of Room. Infact, Room is a part of House. Here, the order is incorrect.

3) Pencil ∶ Lead

→ Pencil is not a part of Lead. Infact, Lead is a part of Pencil. Here, the order is incorrect.

4) Bicycle ∶ Pedal

→ Bicycle is not a part of Pedal. Infact, Pedal is a part of Bicycle. Here, the order is incorrect.

Here, we can see that only Option 1 follow the logic.

Hence, the correct answer is " Student: Class ".

questions.solution:
The logic is:

Farsightedness (hyperopia) is a common vision condition in which you can see distant objects clearly, but objects nearby may be blurry.

Similarly,

Gout is a painful form of arthritis. When your body has extra uric acid, sharp crystals may form in the big toe or other joints, causing episodes of swelling and pain called gout attacks. Gout usually affects the big toe, but it can occur in any joint.

Hence, ‘Joints’ is the correct answer.

Additional InformationHeart: The heart is a muscular organ in most animals, which pumps blood through the blood vessels of the circulatory system. The pumped blood carries oxygen and nutrients to the body, while carrying metabolic waste such as carbon dioxide to the lungs.

Liver: The liver is a large, meaty organ that sits on the right side of the belly. Weighing about 3 pounds, the liver is reddish-brown in color and feels rubbery to the touch. Normally you can't feel the liver, because it's protected by the rib cage. The liver has two large sections, called the right and the left lobes

questions.question: 'Orthopaedician' is related to 'Bones' and 'Dermatologist' is related to 'Skin' in the same way as 'Neonatologist' is related to '_______'.
questions.questionHtml: 'Orthopaedician' is related to 'Bones' and 'Dermatologist' is related to 'Skin' in the same way as 'Neonatologist' is related to '_______'.
questions.solution:
The logic is:

An orthopedician/orthopedics surgeon is a doctor who specializes in diagnosing and treating all conditions related to the skeletomuscular system. The orthopedic doctor will work to repair and preserve the bones, joints, ligaments, and skeleton.

A dermatologist is a medical practitioner qualified to diagnose and treat skin disorders.

Similarly,

Neonatologists are doctors who specialize in the care of newborn children (Infants).

Hence, ‘Infants’ is the correct answer.

Key Points 

  • Neonatology is a subspecialty of pediatrics that consists of the medical care of newborn infants, especially the ill or premature newborns.
  • It is a hospital-based specialty and is usually practiced in neonatal intensive care units.
  • A neonatal intensive care unit (NICU), also known as an intensive care nursery (ICN), is an intensive care unit (ICU) specializing in the care of ill or premature newborn infants.
  • Neonatal refers to the first 28 days of life.
  • Neonatal care, as known as specialized nurseries or intensive care, has been around since the 1960s.
  • The first American newborn intensive care unit, designed by Louis Gluck, was opened in October 1960 at Yale-New Haven Hospital.​

Additional Information

Gynaecology Gynaecology or gynaecology is the medical practice dealing with the health of the female reproductive system.
Cytology

Cytology, the study of cells as fundamental units of living things.
